name: Fleur de Lis Camp
description_short: A non-profit traditional sleepaway camp for girls, founded in 1929, on Laurel Lake in Fitzwilliam, NH. Sessions run from 2 to 7 weeks for rising 3rd–10th graders. Rising 11th and 12th graders can apply to a Counselor in Training program.
refund_policy_summary: You pay a $500 deposit when you register. If you applied for tuition assistance and can't enroll after reviewing the aid offer, the deposit is refunded. The page gives no other refund terms.
swim_waterfront_notes: The camp is on the shores of Laurel Lake. The page gives no details about swimming or the waterfront program.

warnings: The camp is for girls only.
The page gives dates without a year. They were read as 2027 because the page is for Summer 2027, and the weekdays shown match the 2027 calendar.
The lowest price ($3,150) is for the Counselor in Training program, which is by application for rising 11th–12th graders. Regular camper sessions start at $4,550.
The 2-week Starter sessions are for first-time campers only.
Families who register by October 31, 2026 get a 5% early discount. Other discounts: $750 for referrals (both families) and a sibling discount.
No session was marked FULL when this was read, so availability is recorded as open.
